romaji: Fuzuki-san, ashita no paatii no junbi wa mou owarimashita ka?
english: Mr./Ms. Fuzuki, have you finished preparing for tomorrow's party yet?
exampleRomaji: Fuzuki-san, ashita no paatii no junbi wa mou owari mashita ka?
japaneseFurigana: ふずきさん、明日(あした)のパーティーの準備(じゅんび)はもう終(お)わりましたか？
exampleEn: Fuzuki, have you finished preparing for tomorrow's party yet?
audioPath: clips/001_ふずきさん、明日のパーティーの準備はもう終わりましたか.wav
grammar2: 終(お)わる (to finish) ↔ 始(はじ)まる (to start)

romaji: Iie, mada owatte imasen.
english: No, I haven't finished yet.
exampleRomaji: Iie, mada owatte imasen.
japaneseFurigana: いいえ、まだ終(お)わっていません。
exampleEn: No, I haven't finished yet.
audioPath: clips/002_いいえ、まだ終わっていません。.wav
grammar2: まだ + 否定(ひてい) = not yet

romaji: Nimotsu ga ooi desu kara, ima kara kaidashi ni ikimasu.
english: Because there's a lot of luggage, I'm going shopping now.
exampleRomaji: Nimotsu ga ooi desu kara, ima kara kaidashi ni ikimasu.
japaneseFurigana: 荷物(にもつ)が多(おお)いですから、今(いま)から買(か)い出(だ)しに行(い)きます。
exampleEn: Because there's a lot of stuff, I'm going shopping now.
audioPath: clips/003_荷物が多いですから、今から買い出しに行きます。.wav
grammar2: 多(おお)い (many/much) ↔ 少(すく)ない (few/little)

romaji: Nani o kai ni ikimasu ka?
english: What are you going to buy?
exampleRomaji: Nani o kai ni ikimasu ka?
japaneseFurigana: 何(なに)を買(か)いに行(い)きますか？
exampleEn: What are you going to buy?
audioPath: clips/004_何を買いに行きますか.wav
grammar2: 行(い)く (to go) ↔ 来(く)る (to come)

romaji: Suupaa desu ka?
english: At the supermarket?
exampleRomaji: Suupaa desu ka?
japaneseFurigana: スーパーですか？
exampleEn: At the supermarket?
audioPath: clips/005_スーパーですか.wav
grammar2: スーパー = supermarket

romaji: Nomimono to okashi o takusan kau tsumori desu.
english: I plan to buy a lot of drinks and snacks.
exampleRomaji: Nomimono to okashi o ooku kau tsumori desu.
japaneseFurigana: 飲(のみ)物(もの)とお菓子(かし)をたくさん買(か)うつもりです。
exampleEn: I plan to buy a lot of drinks and snacks.
audioPath: clips/006_飲み物とお菓子をたくさん買うつもりです。.wav
grammar2: 〜つもりです = plan to / intend to

romaji: Takusan hitsuyou desu kara.
english: Because we need a lot.
exampleRomaji: Ooku hitsuyou desu kara.
japaneseFurigana: たくさん必要(ひつよう)ですから。
exampleEn: Because we need a lot.
audioPath: clips/007_たくさん必要ですから。.wav
grammar2: 必要(ひつよう) (necessary) ↔ 不(ふ)必要(ひつよう) (unnecessary)

romaji: Nimotsu ga omoku narimasu kara, watashi mo issho ni ikimasu yo.
english: Since the luggage will be heavy, I'll go with you too.
exampleRomaji: Nimotsu ga omoku narimasu kara, watashi mo issho ni ikimasu yo.
japaneseFurigana: 荷物(にもつ)が重(おも)くなりますから、私(わたし)も一(いっ)緒(しょ)に行(い)きますよ。
exampleEn: Since the luggage will be heavy, I'll go with you too.
audioPath: clips/008_荷物が重くなりますから、私も一緒に行きますよ。.wav
grammar2: 重(おも)い (heavy) ↔ 軽(かる)い (light)

romaji: Kuruma o unten shimasu.
english: I'll drive the car.
exampleRomaji: Kuruma o unten shimasu.
japaneseFurigana: 車(くるま)を運転(うんてん)します。
exampleEn: I'll drive the car.
audioPath: clips/009_車を運転します。.wav
grammar2: 運転(うんてん)する = to drive

romaji: Arigatou gozaimasu.
english: Thank you very much.
exampleRomaji: Arigatou gozaimasu.
japaneseFurigana: ありがとうございます。
exampleEn: Thank you very much.
audioPath: clips/010_ありがとうございます。.wav
grammar2: ありがとうございます = Thank you very much

romaji: Tasukarimasu.
english: That helps a lot.
exampleRomaji: Tasukarimasu.
japaneseFurigana: 助(たす)かります。
exampleEn: That helps a lot. / I really appreciate it.
audioPath: clips/011_助かります。.wav
grammar2: 助(たす)かる = to be helped / to be a lifesaver

romaji: Hitori de wa taihen deshita kara.
english: It was tough to do it alone, so...
exampleRomaji: Hitori de wa taihen deshita kara.
japaneseFurigana: 一人(ひとり)では大変(たいへん)でしたから。
exampleEn: It was tough to do it alone, so...
audioPath: clips/012_一人では大変でしたから。.wav
grammar2: 大(たい)変(へん) (tough/hard) ↔ 楽(らく)な (easy)

romaji: Paatii ni wa nan-nin kurai kimasu ka?
english: About how many people will come to the party?
exampleRomaji: Pātī ni wa nan-nin kurai kimasu ka?
japaneseFurigana: パーティーには何人(なんにん)くらい来(き)ますか？
exampleEn: About how many people will come to the party?
audioPath: clips/013_パーティーには何人くらい来ますか.wav
grammar2: 〜くらい = about / approximately

romaji: Zenbu de ni-juu-nin kurai kuru yotei desu.
english: About 20 people in total are planning to come.
exampleRomaji: Zenbu de ni-jū-nin kurai kuru yotei desu.
japaneseFurigana: 全部(ぜんぶ)で二十人(にじゅうにん)くらい来(く)る予定(よてい)です。
exampleEn: About 20 people in total are planning to come.
audioPath: clips/014_全部で20人くらい来る予定です。.wav
grammar2: 予定(よてい) = plan / schedule

romaji: Totemo nigiyaka ni narimasu.
english: It will be very lively.
exampleRomaji: Totemo nigiyaka ni narimasu.
japaneseFurigana: とても賑(にぎ)やかになります。
exampleEn: It will be very lively.
audioPath: clips/015_とても賑やかになります。.wav
grammar2: 賑(にぎ)やかな (lively) ↔ 静(しず)かな (quiet)

romaji: Ni-juu-nin desu ka, ookina paatii ni narimasu ne.
english: Twenty people? That will be a big party, won't it?
exampleRomaji: Ni-jū-nin desu ka, ōkina pātī ni narimasu ne.
japaneseFurigana: 二十人(にじゅうにん)ですか、大(おお)きなパーティーになりますね。
exampleEn: Twenty people? That will be a big party, won't it?
audioPath: clips/016_20人ですか、大きなパーティーになりますね。.wav
grammar2: 大(おお)きい (big) ↔ 小(ちい)さい (small)

romaji: Heya wa doko desu ka?
english: Where is the room?
exampleRomaji: Heya wa doko desu ka?
japaneseFurigana: 部屋(へや)はどこですか？
exampleEn: Where is the room?
audioPath: clips/017_部屋はどこですか.wav
grammar2: 部屋(へや) = room

romaji: Kaisha no chikaku no rentaru ruumu desu.
english: It's a rental room near the company.
exampleRomaji: Kaisha no chikaku no rentaru rūmu desu.
japaneseFurigana: 会(かい)社(しゃ)の近(ちか)くのレンタルルームです。
exampleEn: It's a rental room near the company.

grammar2: 近(ちか)く (near) ↔ 遠(とお)く (far)

romaji: Asoko wa hirokute kirei desu yo.
english: That place is spacious and clean, you know.
exampleRomaji: Asoko wa hirokute kirei desu yo.
japaneseFurigana: あそこは広(ひろ)くて綺(き)麗(れい)ですよ。
exampleEn: That place is spacious and clean, you know.

grammar2: 広(ひろ)い (spacious/wide) ↔ 狭(せま)い (narrow)

japaneseFurigana: あ、あそこですか。
exampleEn: Oh, is that the place?
audioPath: clips/020_あ、あそこですか。.wav

romaji: Tashika ni atarashii tatemono desu kara, yoi basho desu ne.
english: It's certainly a new building, so it's a good location, isn't it?
exampleRomaji: Tashika ni atarashii tatemono desu kara, yoi basho desu ne.
japaneseFurigana: 確(たし)かに新(あたら)しい建(たて)物(もの)ですから、良(よ)い場(ば)所(しょ)ですね。

audioPath: clips/021_確かに新しい建物ですから、良い場所ですね。.wav

japaneseFurigana: はい、でもゴミは全(ぜん)部(ぶ)持(も)って帰(かえ)らなければなりません。

romaji: Soko wa kibishii desu.

japaneseFurigana: そこは厳(きび)しいです。

audioPath: clips/023_そこは厳しいです。.wav
grammar2: 厳(きび)しい (strict) ↔ 優(やさ)しい (kind/lenient)

romaji: Sou desu ka, sore wa chotto taihen desu ne.

exampleEn: Is that so? That sounds a bit tough, doesn't it?

romaji: Ookii gomibukuro ga takusan hitsuyou desu ne.
english: You'll need a lot of large trash bags, won't you?
exampleRomaji: Ōkii gomibukuro ga takusan hitsuyō desu ne.

romaji: Wakarimashita.
